_comments.model_type: Selects the PolarMACE calculator architecture used by this checkpoint.
_comments.instructions: Contains options interpreted by the i-PI MACE wrapper rather than by the MACE model constructor. Field selection is supplied at run time by FFDielectric, so no ensemble key is needed here.
_comments.compute_BEC: Disables response derivatives because MACE applies the electric field directly in this example.
_comments.ignore: Skips copying unused optional model outputs from the device to CPU; required field-dependent energy, force, stress, and dipole data remain available.
